Hero.title: Senior software engineer. Software built properly.
Hero.intro1: I've worked on large products people depend on, including government apps and payments software. I know what it takes to keep them healthy long after launch.
Hero.intro2: I can help with your product, whether that means joining your team, building it from the first idea to release, or reviewing what you already have and telling you plainly what to fix first.

government-platform.name: Government platform
government-platform.summary: A government platform used by tens of thousands of people, with live location tracking and maps. People confirm who they are with official identity documents, so keeping their personal data private and secure came first.
government-platform.part: I joined a well-defined project and owned my work from the product owner's ticket to production: refinement, estimates, architecture proposals, implementation and store releases, in an agile team working closely with the product owner, designers, QA and the other teams.
government-platform.partShort: Owned my work from the product owner's ticket to production, in an agile team working closely with the product owner, designers, QA and other teams.
government-platform.alt: Illustration: a phone over a map, with a live location route

payments-app.name: Payments app
payments-app.summary: A digital currency you pay with by tapping your phone: money held on custom Java Cards and the phone's secure hardware, with every transaction recorded on a blockchain that all parties can see.
payments-app.part: In a small team, I built the Android side of the card communication: sending APDU commands to the cards over NFC, with the retries, failure handling, testing and debugging that make it dependable.
payments-app.partShort: In a small team, built the Android side of the card communication: APDU commands over NFC, with retries and failure handling.
payments-app.stack: NFC · Java Card · APDU · Android Secure Element · gRPC
payments-app.alt: Illustration: a phone paying by tapping a card

gym-tracker.name: Gym Tracker
gym-tracker.summary: A private workout tracker with no ads and no bloat. I built it because no app did only what I wanted.
gym-tracker.part: I had the idea, designed it, built the Android app and the backend from one API contract that CI checks, and put it on Google Play. Every architecture decision is written down in the repo, so the reasoning behind the code is there to read.
gym-tracker.partShort: Had the idea, designed it, built the app and backend from one API contract, and put it on Google Play.
gym-tracker.alt: Gym Tracker screens: a workout plan and an active workout

adria-va.name: Adria VA
adria-va.summary: A website for a virtual assistance and bookkeeping business.
adria-va.part: Most of the work happened before any design: working out with the owner what their clients actually needed to see, and turning a broad idea into a clear list of what the site had to do. Then I designed and built it, in English and Croatian.
adria-va.partShort: Worked out with the owner what their clients needed to see, then designed and built the site in English and Croatian.
adria-va.alt: Adria VA homepage in a browser window

About.title: About
About.p1: I'm Ivan Karlo Rukavina, a senior software engineer. Most of my career has been spent in agile teams, working closely with product owners, designers, QA and other engineering teams, and taking responsibility for my work from the ticket to production. Alongside that, I build my own products end to end.
About.p2: What I care about is software that is still easy to work on a year after launch: a clear structure, decisions written down, and no more complexity than the problem needs. Gym Tracker came from the same idea: an app that does only what it should, without ads or bloat.
